## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 - CI green, by fixing the anchor and not by weakening the gate.**
`node services/cockpit/render-vm-check.mjs --self-test` exits 0, every household mutation reports
CAUGHT, and the `cockpit-private-apps` workflow passes on this branch.

**AC2 - establish the REAL cause before changing anything.** Larry established that
`'page page-pad'` occurs once in `public/shopping.js` yet is absent from the compiled
`shopOpts.template`. **He did NOT establish why.** Find out. Candidates worth checking and
discarding on evidence, not on plausibility: the anchor sits in a string the compile step rewrites;
`captured[1]` is no longer the shopping app (a second app registration was added for the CareerAIR
grid - the template check reports "2 app(s) registered, views: asdair[...] careerair[grid]"); the
template is assembled at runtime rather than being the file's literal text; quoting or whitespace
differs after compilation. **State the cause with the evidence that proves it.**

**AC3 - the gate keeps its teeth. THIS IS THE POINT OF THE ORDER.**
Whatever you change, the self-test must still FAIL when the thing it guards is broken. **Prove it by
mutation:** break the anchor deliberately, show the self-test goes red, restore, show it goes green.
**A self-test that passes because it quietly stopped checking is a worse defect than the red CI you
were sent to fix.** If your fix cannot be mutation-proven, say so rather than shipping it.

**AC4 - do not touch the other three workflows.** `secret-scan`, `build-002-tests` and
`control-plane-tests` are green; leave them alone.
